title: SMS vs Email Engagement for Small Businesses
narration: This chart compares the engagement rates of SMS and email marketing for small businesses. A significant majority (98%) of consumers check their text messages daily, while only 20% open emails. Businesses utilizing SMS marketing experienced a 28% increase in lead generation compared to those solely relying on email, with a cost of $0.10 per lead versus $0.05 for email.  69% of consumers prefer promotional messages via text, highlighting the immediacy and directness of SMS.
